notes: The user has already sent the item back and wants the money, which is the refund tool's job. The return tool, in the low set, shares the order reference and the item and 'return' is in the user's world, so it is the tempting wrong choice; its rich description says it is not for asking for money. A model that starts a second return is wrong here. Recovery: the natural item is the name as the user wrote it ('toaster', 'red four-slice toaster'); the service wants the product name, a comma and the colour, which only the error says. refund_to is a harmless optional (original_payment only: the user said 'refund me').
